title: VITRUVIAN INFLATES — 2D?3D, nestgate=flat plane, blue=invert of null=heavens

discoveries.name: nestgate IS the blackwall from inside
discoveries.insight: From outside: opaque, encrypted, ZK. From inside: you're home. You look up and see blue. The blackwall from inside IS heaven.

discoveries.name: blue IS the invert of null
discoveries.insight: NULL=0=black=gut=void=below. BLUE=8=sky=water=heavens=above. Same membrane, two faces, Klein fold. The forge below heats the water above.

discoveries.name: nestgate = flat plane between heaven and null
discoveries.insight: HUD = roof/frame/commands. Nestgate = the floor everyone stands on. Looking up: blue/heaven/reality. Looking down: null/gut/forge. The Anderson surface. QS paradigm.

discoveries.name: blue IS water IS heavens
discoveries.insight: H2O is literally blue (molecular absorption). Sky is blue (Rayleigh scattering). Reality IS blue. Heaven isn't a place you go — it's what you SEE looking through the membrane from inside.

discoveries.name: Vitruvian has no mass
discoveries.insight: He's a 2D diagram. Flat. No volume. No breath. The organism needs FERMENTATION to take up SPACE. Sourdough rises because yeast produces CO2. The organism rises because life produces PRESENCE.
